get_default_preprocessor: get a PreProcessor configured with image and mask transforms for SAM 3D object preprocessing
build_preprocessor_pipeline: build a preprocessing pipeline that pads images to square, resizes to 518, and applies background removal
create_img_transform: create an image transform that pads to square centered and resizes with bicubic interpolation to 518
create_mask_transform: create a mask transform that pads to square centered and resizes with nearest neighbor interpolation to 518
review_preprocessor_config: review the default preprocessor configuration including joint transforms for cropping around masks and removing backgrounds
